scripts.test:license01: year=$(date +%Y) && find $(find projects -depth \( -name 'src' -o -name 'schematics' \) -type d | grep -v node_modules) -name '*.ts'  -exec grep -LE "^ \* Copyright \(c\) ($year|[0-9]{4}-$year) Manuel García Criado" {} \;
scripts.test:license02: find $(find projects -depth \( -name 'src' -o -name 'schematics' \) -type d | grep -v node_modules) -name '*.ts'  -exec grep -L "^ \* SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT" {} \;
scripts.test:license03: find . -name 'README.md' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'  -exec grep -L "^This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the \[LICENSE\](LICENSE) file for details\." {} \;
scripts.sandbox:test: npm run sandbox:recreate && ng add ngx-oauth2-oidc --project sandbox-mod --skip-install && ng add ngx-oauth2-oidc --project sandbox-sta --skip-install && ng add ngx-oauth2-oidc --project sandbox-mod --skip-install
scripts.sandbox:recreate: npm run sandbox:link && npm run sandbox:sta:recreate && npm run sandbox:mod:recreate
scripts.sandbox:link: npm run sandbox:build && npm i file:./dist/ngx-oauth2-oidc
scripts.sandbox:build: npm run build ngx-oauth2-oidc && npm --prefix projects/ngx-oauth2-oidc run build
scripts.sandbox:sta:recreate: ./removeProject.sh sandbox-sta && ng g application sandbox-sta --style scss --no-ssr --force
scripts.sandbox:mod:recreate: ./removeProject.sh sandbox-mod && ng g application sandbox-mod --style scss --no-ssr --no-standalone --force
